candidates.candidate: A. MET kinase domain inhibitor DMS (Estevam et al., eLife 2025; Ba/F3 TPR-MET)
candidates.access_terms: Article: Creative Commons Attribution (Crossref: CC BY 4.0). Repository fraser-lab/MET_kinase_Inhibitor_DMS (commit c2052b97): LICENSE = MIT, copyright Fraser Lab 2024; article data statement: 'Original data files, analysis, and source code is available at' that repository; raw reads at SRA PRJNA1136906 (not downloaded). The MIT text refers to 'Software and associated documentation files'; whether it is the stated licence of the data tables is not spelled out.
candidates.endpoint: Rosace effect (log2 fitness scale; wild-type synonymous = 0) per variant and condition; 12 conditions: DMSO + 11 inhibitors, each dosed at its experimentally determined IC50 (not a common exposure scale); IL-3 withdrawal selection. Posterior sd of the filtered scores: median 0.45, max 0.65 (replicate values not in the files read).
candidates.counts: measured: 287 positions (UniProt P08581 1059-1345, wild-type identity verified at all positions), 11 inhibitors, 4618 DMSO missense variants of 5453 possible, 4466-4842 per inhibitor; 4364 variants in all 12 conditions; 1 source group (one laboratory, one assay system)
candidates.function_control: DMSO condition per variant: 2513 of 4618 DMSO missense variants (54%) are flagged loss-of-function, so the drug effect is interpretable only for the 1906-2036 DMSO-tolerated variants per inhibitor; expression and folding are not measured separately
candidates.structures: 8 PDB entries downloaded (X-ray, 1.20-2.49 Å): experimental ligand complexes for 7 inhibitors (2WGJ, 6SDE, 4EEV, 5T3Q, 3RHK, 4R1V, 3QTI) plus ATP-bound 3DKC; 4 inhibitors (capmatinib, glumetinib, cabozantinib, glesatinib analog) have no experimental structure (docked per the article; poses not in the files read); resolved scanned-span residues per entry 263-287 of 287; engineered differences from P08581: 3QTI Y1194F, Y1234F; 3DKC Y1194F, Y1234F, Y1235D
candidates.evaluation: unit = variant-drug; group = position (287); dependent across the ~19 substitutions of a position and across drugs (shared libraries and DMSO control); drug confounded with template; single assay and laboratory, so no transfer claim beyond it
candidates.exposure: published XGBoost models in the repository (14 features incl. ESM-1b log-likelihood ratio, stability, distance, conformation; test = two held-out inhibitors, 20% of positions, two amino acids); ESM-1b correlation reported 0.50 (DMSO) against 0.28 (inhibitor-treated). MET structures were used as evaluation entries in KIN-GEN-2 (a different task).

candidates.access_terms: MaveDB record: licence field null; no primary publication or DOI in the record
candidates.endpoint: log enrichment, median over synonymous codons, two replicates; 'only a small subset of variants were reported'
candidates.counts: measured: 73 variants, 1 drug, target sequence 119 residues
candidates.structures: not assessed (stopped at access and provenance)
candidates.evaluation: one drug: template-drug confounding cannot be separated; too few units for a position-grouped comparison
candidates.verdict: does not qualify: one drug, partial reporting, no licence field, no linked source
